variants.specifics: Brackenford: Ulric, an old shepherd at the edge of the Ashwood, wants the wolves that ate his sheep and dug a den under his hut driven out.

offer.speaker: Ulric
offer.text:
Welcome, stranger! Welcome!

I had the stakes all cut for a new sheep pen. Too late, I fear.

The wolves of the Ashwood are the boldest and most wicked beasts in the land, and they've eaten my sheep, and now they've dug a den right under my own floor!

Well, don't just stand there! Chase them out of my hut at the edge of the woods and I'll pay you well, only hurry!

reminder.speaker: Ulric
reminder.text: Stranger! Go and run those wolves off!

completion.speaker: Ulric
completion.text: Oh, thank you, thank you, good and brave Adventurer! Here's your gold -- now I can finally sleep in my own bed again!

journal.text: Find the wolves' den under Ulric's hut and clear it out.

variants.specifics: Varrhold: Nella's bathhouse pool has filled with Giant Leeches and she pays to have them killed.

offer.speaker: Nella
offer.text:
Eeeeeek!

Giant Leeches have filled my bath pool, and I think my strongbox can spare a fair bit of gold to anyone who gets rid of them.

I can keep the miners out, but you'll have to wade in yourself when you reach the pool down the west tunnel. I can't swat them away with this broom much longer!

reminder.speaker: Nella
reminder.text: One of the old miners -- the one with the bad cough -- said Leeches can't stand fire. Maybe that will chase them out of the water!

completion.speaker: Nella
completion.text: Oh, thank you, thank you! You've saved my bathhouse! How will I ever pay you back for such courage?! Here, take this purse. Now I'll go heat up the water.

journal.text: Go to Nella's bathhouse and kill the Giant Leeches.

variants.specifics: Skeel: Old Nubbin's bathhouse has been taken over by a nest of Giant Leeches and he wants them squashed.

offer.speaker: Nubbin
offer.text: Please, help an old man! The leeches have come back! I won't put up with it any longer -- a whole nest of them is living under my bathhouse, west of here! I don't know when I'll get a proper bath again unless somebody goes down there and squashes every last one of them, and I'll make it worth your while.

reminder.speaker: Nubbin
reminder.text: That nest must be under the floor somewhere!

completion.speaker: Nubbin
completion.text: They're dead!? I could never pay you what a hot bath is worth, but please take these boots as a token of my appreciation!

journal.text: Nubbin's bathhouse has been overrun by Giant Leeches, but the hatch down to their nest is stuck fast. Perhaps the nest can be reached from the water...

variants.specifics: Gorst: Gribbin the pedlar hauled a wagon of boots to the garrison and Scorpions have nested in every pair.

offer.speaker: Gribbin
offer.text: Greetings, young sir. I've gone to great bother and my own expense, hauling a wagon of fine leather boots to these poor barefoot soldiers -- and now Scorpions have nested in every last pair, down in the stable yard west of the gate! Clear them out and I'll make it worth your while.

completion.speaker: Gribbin
completion.text: Congratulations, brave Adventurer! Here, try a pair of these boots on the next Scorpion you meet.

journal.text: Go to the stable yard and drive the Scorpions out of Gribbin's wagon.

variants.specifics: Ombry: Grella the washerwoman wants the Giant Leeches cleared out of the Washing Cove, where nobody can wash a shirt.

offer.speaker: Grella
offer.text: Good day, brave Adventurer. A worthy reward to whoever rids the Washing Cove south of the docks of those horrid Giant Leeches -- not one shirt in Ombry has been washed since they came!

reminder.speaker: Grella
reminder.text: The Washing Cove? Follow the shore path and keep the water on your left..

completion.speaker: Grella
completion.text: We never should have let those leeches breed so close to the village. There must have been scores of them in that cove! Take these boots, and keep out of Gurlok's way if you want to keep your hide!

journal.text: Clear the Giant Leeches from the Washing Cove

variants.specifics: Merinth: Fennick, who keeps the College treasury, pays to have the Mimics cleared out of the College storeroom.

offer.speaker: Fennick
offer.text: Hello there, would you care to earn a fat purse from the College treasury? Mimics have crept into our storeroom, which lies in the cellar under the north wing, and every chest down there could bite your arm off!

reminder.speaker: Fennick
reminder.text: Now that you've heard about it, we need those Mimics out of the cellar!

completion.speaker: Fennick
completion.text: Marvelous! The College owes you a great debt for this. Here is your purse, as promised -- and please, go see Master Oswick. It would appear there's no job too big for you!

journal.text: Lure the Mimics out of the College storeroom chests and destroy them.

variants.specifics: Fort Vosk: Gorbo the brewer has been chased out of his own ale cellar by Bats and pays a bounty to have them cleared.

offer.speaker: Gorbo
offer.text:
Will somebody listen to me?!

The Bats chased me clean out of the cellar under my brewhouse...

You're not from around here. That cellar has lots of twisty passages and a few old traps, which were first built to keep thirsty soldiers away from the ale. Clear those Bats out and I'll pay you a good bounty.

reminder.speaker: Gorbo
reminder.text: The Bats are still down there. Hear 'em?

completion.speaker: Gorbo
completion.text: Oh, bless you, good and brave stranger! This gold will surely help you against the Necromancer's dead. Really gone? I bet that Necromancer sent them down there.

journal.text: Drive the Bats out of the cellar under Gorbo's brewhouse. It runs beneath the west wall and down into the old cisterns.

variants.specifics: Durgal: Zeck, an odd old bellows-man, pays to be rid of the Bats nesting inside his great bellows below the forge.

offer.speaker: Zeck
offer.text:
Bats have nested inside my great bellows below the forge! There's no time to send for help. Down by the gate a woman named Mirva sells potions you'll surely be needing.

Now, I don't much care for heroes and their grand quests, but let me make it worth your while, friend. You look like the sort who'll do a job for coin, so I figured I'd put some your way. Heh, heh, heh...

reminder.speaker: Zeck
reminder.text: I've got nothing else to tell you just now. Good luck with those bats. They can be noisy and filthy bunch.

completion.speaker: Zeck
completion.text: Ha-HA! Now, take this purse and off you go.

journal.text:
Hunt down the Bats in order to free Zeck's great bellows.
Their nest is likely somewhere under the forge.

variants.specifics: Pellor's Cross: Wila's bathhouse behind the inn is haunted by Ghosts and she pays to have them banished.

offer.speaker: Wila
offer.text: It is the most dreadful of hauntings! I heard them in my bathhouse behind the inn, moaning by the big tub in an old man's voice. Ghosts love to catch a man with his trousers off! Get rid of them and I'll make it worth your while.

reminder.speaker: Wila
reminder.text: I still have your reward put by.

completion.speaker: Wila
completion.text: Thank you! Here, this gold and these leather boots will be of use -- more than you'd guess.

journal.text: Banish the Ghosts in Wila's bathhouse.

variants.writer: Claude Agent SDK general-purpose agent, Claude Opus 5.5

variants.specifics: Vellin: Fennick, an old farmer, wants the Giant Bats cleared out of his barn west of town, because his cows have stopped giving milk.

offer.speaker: Fennick
offer.text:
Bats have moved into my barn, west of town, and my cows won't give a single drop of milk! Clear them out... I hope you brought a good stout club.

Heh, heh, heh... Rid my barn of those pests and this old farmer will open his purse and his pantry to you.

reminder.speaker: Fennick
reminder.text: So many bats in so small a barn! Swat them if you can!

completion.speaker: Fennick
completion.text: No more bats! Thank you, kind sir! I can't pay you near what it's worth, but please take these boots as a token of my appreciation!

journal.text: Show Fennick that his barn is rid of the Giant Bats.
